steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 40-second launch film for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, 30 fps.

Before you design anything, learn the product: read [your product URL], and the codebase if you have it. Write down in one line what it does and who it is for, list its three strongest features, and show me that summary first.

Story:
1. Hook, first second: one bold line that names the problem [your product] solves.
2. Meet the product: its real interface, logo, colours and type.
3. Five beats, one per feature, building in intensity.
4. End card: logo, one-line promise and [your product URL].

Look and motion: cinematic and dramatic, cut like a film trailer: a slow build, a dark palette with one accent colour, big type reveals on the hits.

Sound: compose an original score in code in the spirit of a big, tense film soundtrack: a slow build, a pulse that speeds up, and a final hit on the logo. Give every reveal its own sound and mix so nothing clips.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.

original.label: Prompt
original.text: Make a dynamic 40-second motion graphics video on Distilbook that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel - go all out. Use the Oppenheimer theme music as inspiration, but compose it yourself.
